notes: Contraction of the Elements' authorship: the removed fact is written_by(elements, euclid), and nothing replaces it, so every answer that rested on it is unknown. A career in Alexandria (a class, AlexandriaScholar, since RELATIONS.md has no relation for it) and the Optics are stored facts about Euclid, reached through the removed authorship. The related question asks whether the Euclidean algorithm is named after the author of the Elements: named_after is functional, so the algorithm's namesake is Euclid, and with the authorship removed the claim neither follows nor fails.
